title: Authentication required by default
statement: The system shall require authentication for every client connection by default, supporting SCRAM-SHA-256, x.509 client certificates and OIDC tokens.
rationale: Unauthenticated defaults are the commonest real-world database breach.

acceptance_criteria.text: A freshly installed node rejects unauthenticated connections and listens only on loopback until explicitly configured otherwise.
A client can authenticate successfully with each of SCRAM-SHA-256, x.509 and OIDC.
